incidents.name: NXUSD Cauldron oracle manipulation
incidents.notes: The NXUSD CauldronV2 market valued its Curve LP collateral from the pool's live state, so an Aave flash loan that imbalanced the two Curve pools let the attacker borrow far more NXUSD than the deposited collateral was worth.

sources.ref: onchain review: CauldronV2 0xC0A7a7F141b6A5Bce3EC1B81823c8AFA456B6930 created 2022-09-05T10:20:47Z by 0x6b4020dc274283afc240feccc27eff3a1f0f44f4, not the attack-tx sender 0x69992a2e5d6ec031ab16733975110f0b43a0b1af; no EIP-1967 events, so the executing code was 1.38 days old. Loss 50,000 USD per the DeFiHackLabs 2022 index entry for this PoC. Recheck of the deployment basis (DELEGATECALL audit): the victim is an EIP-1167 minimal-proxy clone whose 45-byte runtime hardcodes the master 0xe767c6c3bf42f550a5a258a379713322b6c4c060, so the DELEGATECALL target cannot be repointed; the master's runtime is byte-identical at the clone's creation block 19560264 and the incident block 19613453 and contains no DELEGATECALL, so deployment is exact.
